title: Prince Hans-Adam expects Jesus on a flying saucer

tellings.quote: The royal prince of Liechtenstein, Hans-Adam. He believes Jesus will show up on a flying saucer.

plain: Hans-Adam II, the reigning prince of Liechtenstein, is said to believe that Jesus will return on a flying saucer. Michels says this himself, without naming a source: "He believes Jesus will show up on a flying saucer." He raises it as a sign of how far UFO ideas reach into religious belief among the powerful.
